note: Realistic filled-in states in the scoring engine's shape. `expected` is computed by `bin/test-personas --update` and verified by `bin/test-personas`. FIXED 2026-09-06: `deriveRecommendation`'s `redirect` recommendation (interpretationBand === 'misuse-risk') used to be unreachable in practice — `scoreAppropriateness` forces `usually-not-appropriate` in the exact same screening-misuse case that `scoreInterpretation` forces `misuse-risk`, and `deriveRecommendation` checked the appropriateness band first, so screening misuse always resolved to query-referrer, never redirect. Fixed by checking `misuse-risk` first in both `js/grader.js` and `src/lib/engine/grader.ts`; the other route to `usually-not-appropriate` (every selected marker mismatched, no screening misuse involved) is unaffected and still resolves to query-referrer. The third persona below (renamed from its old `query-referrer-...` name) now correctly recommends `redirect`. Separately noted, NOT fixed here (out of this specific finding's scope, and needs a product decision this session isn't positioned to make unilaterally): the `reject` recommendation in `RECOMMENDATION_LABELS` has no trigger anywhere in `deriveRecommendation` either, so it is equally unreachable — see tasks.md Phase 13.

personas.name: redirect-screening-high-risk-psa-misuse-incomplete
personas.description: A 'well man' PSA check requested as broad screening rather than for a specific clinical indication: PSA nominally matches the screening-high-risk indication in the marker-to-indication map, but this engine forces broad screening itself to usually-not-appropriate regardless of that per-marker match. FIXED 2026-09-06: `deriveRecommendation` used to check the generic `usually-not-appropriate` appropriateness band before the `misuse-risk` interpretation band, so `redirect` was unreachable — every screening-misuse case (which always forces both bands together, since interpretationBand's misuse-risk is driven by the exact same screeningMisuse flag as appropriatenessBand) always resolved to the generic `query-referrer` first. Reordered so `misuse-risk` is checked first; this persona now correctly recommends `redirect` rather than `query-referrer`. Several administrative fields are not yet captured — expect usually-not-appropriate + misuse-risk interpretation + routine + redirect, completeness below 100.
